title: The Envoy's Arrival
narrative_hooks: A rival lord's envoy arrives at court bearing demands and thinly veiled threats
The shift from local governance to regional politics begins here
This marks the end of Act 1 — the player can no longer ignore the wider world
Claude should emphasize the weight of this moment: the player's domain is now on the map

options.label: Accept the tribute terms
options.narrative_hint: Reluctant submission; the player buys time but at a cost to pride and treasury

options.label: Reject the envoy with defiance
options.narrative_hint: Bold refusal; the court rallies but war drums sound on the horizon

options.label: Negotiate a compromise
options.narrative_hint: Shrewd diplomacy; neither side fully satisfied but bloodshed is delayed

title: Death of the Emperor
narrative_hooks: A rider arrives bearing black banners — the emperor is dead with no heir
The realm fractures as every lord with ambition sees a chance at the throne
This is the hinge of the entire story; Act 3 is the endgame
Claude should convey the seismic shock — the old order is gone forever

options.label: Declare your intent for the throne
options.narrative_hint: Bold and public; every eye in the realm turns toward you — ally and enemy alike

options.label: Quietly gather allies behind closed doors
options.narrative_hint: Patient and diplomatic; build strength in the shadows before revealing your hand

options.label: Seize nearby territory while rivals mourn
options.narrative_hint: Ruthlessly aggressive; territory gained but honor questioned — some will call you a vulture

title: The Winds of Change
narrative_hooks: This is a fallback transition that fires when the transition window expires without the primary event triggering
Claude MUST adapt the tone based on which transition is occurring: Act 1->2 should feel like growing threats from beyond your borders; Act 2->3 should feel like the collapse of central authority
Keep it brief but impactful — the player should feel the world shifting under their feet
If transitioning 1->2, reference rising tensions with rival lords; if 2->3, reference power vacuum and chaos

options.label: Embrace the new reality
options.narrative_hint: Forward-looking; the player adapts and looks for opportunity in upheaval

options.label: Fortify and prepare for the worst
options.narrative_hint: Defensive and cautious; shore up defenses at the cost of outward influence

options.label: Act boldly while others hesitate
options.narrative_hint: Opportunistic; risk and reward in equal measure as the player strikes while the iron is hot

title: The Throne Awaits
narrative_hooks: The path to the throne is clear — rivals are defeated or allied, the realm awaits a ruler
This is the narrative epilogue; ALL options lead to victory
Claude should make this feel momentous — the culmination of everything the player has built
Reflect on the player's journey: their choices, sacrifices, and the kind of realm they shaped
The tone should match the option chosen — triumphant, solemn, pragmatic, or populist

options.label: Rule with wisdom and compassion
options.narrative_hint: The just ruler; beloved by the people, a golden age begins — but the treasury bears the cost of generosity

options.label: Rule with an iron fist
options.narrative_hint: The tyrant ascends; order through fear, strength through domination — but the people's love withers

options.label: Build an empire of commerce
options.narrative_hint: The merchant king; gold flows like rivers, trade routes span the realm — but swords rust in their scabbards

options.label: Champion the common folk
options.narrative_hint: The people's champion; the smallfolk rejoice, the nobility grumbles — a new order rises from below

title: The Bandits Return
narrative_hooks: The bandits you previously paid off have returned — emboldened and with greater numbers
Their leader remembers you as an easy mark; the demands are steeper this time
Claude should make the player feel the consequence of their earlier choice to pay rather than fight
The bandits are cocky but not invincible — the player has options

options.label: Crush them with military force
options.narrative_hint: Decisive violence; the bandits underestimated you and pay the price — but soldiers die in the hills

options.label: Pay their increased demands
options.narrative_hint: Throwing gold at the problem again — but this time it costs more and word spreads of your weakness

options.label: Set an ambush at the payment site
options.narrative_hint: Cunning and ruthless; pretend to pay, then spring the trap — risky but could end this permanently

title: The Spy's Report
narrative_hooks: Your spy returns from the rival's court bearing valuable intelligence
Claude should reference which rival was being spied on based on game state flags
The information is explosive — troop movements, secret alliances, or hidden weaknesses
The player must decide how to use this advantage before the intelligence goes stale

options.label: Act on the intelligence immediately
options.narrative_hint: Strike while the iron is hot; use the information for a preemptive advantage — costs resources to mobilize

options.label: Sell the intelligence to another rival
options.narrative_hint: Mercenary pragmatism; gold for secrets — but if your spy is discovered, trust dies

options.label: Keep the intelligence as leverage
options.narrative_hint: Patient scheming; the knowledge is power in itself — reveal it at the perfect moment for maximum effect

title: Alliance Terms Come Due
narrative_hooks: Your ally calls in the terms of your agreement — they need resources, troops, or political support
Claude should reference the specific alliance from game state and make the demand feel proportional
This is the cost of alliances: you gave your word, and now your word is being tested
The player's response will define whether they are trustworthy or treacherous

options.label: Honor the alliance terms in full
options.narrative_hint: Honorable and costly; your word is your bond — allies remember this, and so do potential future allies

options.label: Renegotiate the terms
options.narrative_hint: Diplomatic but risky; pushing back may strain the alliance — or it may find a better balance

options.label: Betray the alliance and keep your resources
options.narrative_hint: Treacherous and self-serving; you keep everything but burn a bridge that may never be rebuilt

title: The Betrayed Return
narrative_hooks: An advisor you dismissed or betrayed has returned seeking vengeance
Claude should reference the specific advisor from game state and their grudge
They have gathered support — disgruntled soldiers, rival sympathizers, or damaging secrets
This is a consequence event: the player's past treatment of their court comes back to haunt them

options.label: Confront them in open court
options.narrative_hint: Direct and risky; a public confrontation that could go either way — strength is respected, but so is a well-aimed accusation

options.label: Buy their silence with gold
options.narrative_hint: Pragmatic bribery; the problem disappears but your coffers are lighter and they know you can be squeezed

options.label: Exile them from the realm
options.narrative_hint: Cold and final; they are removed but carry their grudge to foreign courts where it may poison your reputation
